contacts.name: Emergency (police, fire, medical)
contacts.notes: Police, fire and medical emergencies. Text to 911 works in many areas when you can't safely call.

contacts.name: Poison Control
contacts.notes: Free, confidential, 24/7. Connects you to your local poison center.

contacts.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
contacts.notes: Call or text 988, 24/7, for anyone in emotional distress or crisis.

contacts.name: Disaster Distress Helpline
contacts.notes: Free crisis counseling for anyone affected by a disaster. Call or text, 24/7.

contacts.name: 211 community help
contacts.notes: Local help with shelter, food, utilities and disaster recovery.

contacts.name: FEMA Helpline
contacts.notes: Disaster assistance after a federally declared disaster. You can also apply at DisasterAssistance.gov.

contacts.name: American Red Cross
contacts.notes: Emergency shelters, supplies and help reconnecting with family after disasters.
